profile.headline: Software QA Engineer
profile.summary: I am an alum of the University of Texas at Austin (UT Austin), and I earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science in May 2018. I currently work at Tesla as a Software Quality Assurance Engineer, and am enjoying every day!

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
* Mobile testing, web-based UI testing, back-end API testing, and visual testing with Selenium, Python, and Applitools
* Documented QA sources
* Helped onboard new software QA engineers

positions.title: SDET
positions.description:
* Tested front-end, UI, API, visual testing of functionality/bugs and more with Selenium, Robot Framework, Python, and JavaScript
* Tested on multiple browsers and devices (via Sauce Labs)
* Moved internally to new team and used C#/XUnit, and Ruby/Selenium for unit, front-end, API, back-end testing
* Documented QA resources for single source of truth
* Defined test plans for general features
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Quality Assurance · Software Quality Assurance · Agile Methodologies · Test Automation

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description: Planned and wrote front-end, UI, API tests with Selenium, Robot Framework, Python, and JavaScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Quality Assurance · Software Quality Assurance · Agile Methodologies · Test Automation

positions.title: Software Engineer In Test
positions.description:
Role: Aided software development by being involved in the planning process and by testing the product.
Example Responsibilities:
* Wrote and executed test cases that found defects not previously found in designing features and bug fixes using Java and Selenium.
* Documented test cases for existing REST API code which helped to fill in gaps in automation testing for many products that depended on the API.
* Exposed to Test Engineering ideas, like: test plans/cases/runs, automation, and performance testing

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer in Test
positions.description: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Quality Assurance · Software Quality Assurance · Agile Methodologies · Test Automation

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Role: Helped in many coding projects.
Example Responsibilities:
* Refined and documented existing code base.
* Designed and programmed new back-end projects.
